strengths_deep_dive: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA demonstrates positive financial health, highlighted by a <cite id="1">97.4% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite> that significantly exceeds the 87.4% peer median. Supported by an <cite id="1">overall score of 95.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, the organization spends just <cite id="1">$0.04 to raise every $1</cite> in donations. This lean overhead structure ensures that public gifts directly subsidize medical treatments and clinical infrastructure in Pakistan.
rich_narrative.summary: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA raises funds to support free and subvention-based cancer treatment, clinical services, and diagnostic care in developing nations, primarily targeting healthcare facilities in Pakistan <cite id="1">such as Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital</cite>. In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="3">$23,259,494 in total revenue</cite>, directing an exceptional <cite id="1">98.3% of expenses to program expenses</cite>. This spending allocation significantly surpasses the general industry standard of 75%, allowing the vast majority of donor contributions to directly fund clinical care, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostic equipment. The organization retains <cite id="1">a 95/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, backed by strong financial management and reserves. While the organization delivers critical medical services to impoverished communities and maintains explicit Zakat verification, it retains governance limitations due to a small board structure and currently lacks a formal, published theory of change.
